title: retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Hanging Space Solid Brass Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade storage in tight spaces with this retractable hooks and garment rod solution for wall mount installation. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2-Inch of hanging space, then pushes back in when not in use—ideal for modern bathroom hardware and other contemporary bath accessories where a clean look matters.

Highlights:
- Retractable wall hook / pull-out hanger creates 2-1/2-Inch hanging space, then retracts flush when not needed
- Wall mount design helps keep items organized without taking up floor space (great for minimalist bathroom fixtures)
- Solid brass construction
- Holds up to 15 lb
- Optional customization: remove the supplied knob tip and replace with a cabinet knob of your choice

Specs & Installation:
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 3.75 in W x 2 in H x 2 in L; 1 in projection
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Hardware included: toggle bolts (6/32 toggles)
- Wall compatibility: fits standard interior walls
- Install notes: requires drilling a 3/4 in dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around
- Finish options: multiple designer finishes available, including statement colors

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
